title: I expected a little more
text: I expected a little more. So like anyone else I bought this to store food. Out of the box, the containers are a little heavy, they are glass. Seems fairly airtight. After a few days of use, I noticed the lids are not amazing. After awhile I can see the lids getting worn out and the container may not be as airtight as before. Also be careful with the container bc any type of dings may chip or crack the container. It will store your food and it will last as long your careful with it. It is very easy to clean and great in different temperatures. Hope this helped !
